$comment: DEMONSTRATION PERSPECTIVE LIBRARY — synthetic debate framing. Every perspective is traceable to at least one library source id. The real product links to Britannica ProCon for debate framing where relevant; ProCon article URLs are never invented here.

perspectives.summary: Displacement outpaces new job creation in the short run, and adjustment costs fall unevenly on routine-task workers.
Automation raises output and creates demand in complementary occupations; historically, aggregate employment has absorbed displacement.

perspectives.claim: Economic interdependence discourages war between trading partners.
perspectives.summary: Mutual exposure raises the cost of conflict and creates domestic constituencies for restraint.

perspectives.claim: Economic interdependence discourages war between trading partners.
perspectives.summary: Interdependence creates asymmetric leverage and choke points that can themselves become instruments of coercion.

perspectives.claim: Multipolarity is inherently less stable than bipolarity.
perspectives.summary: More poles mean more dyads, more miscalculation risk and weaker institutional dampening.

perspectives.claim: Multipolarity is inherently less stable than bipolarity.
perspectives.summary: Stability depends less on the number of poles than on the management of specific disputes and the availability of institutional venues.

perspectives.claim: Carbon pricing is the most efficient emissions-reduction instrument.
perspectives.summary: A uniform price equalises marginal abatement costs and mobilises dispersed information.

perspectives.claim: Carbon pricing is the most efficient emissions-reduction instrument.
perspectives.summary: Distributional backlash and the credibility of future prices limit real-world effectiveness; complementary regulation may be necessary.

perspectives.claim: Export controls on advanced technology improve national security.
perspectives.summary: Restricting access to critical inputs slows adversary capability and buys strategic time.

perspectives.claim: Export controls on advanced technology improve national security.
perspectives.summary: Controls accelerate import substitution, fragment the innovation base and impose costs on allied firms.

perspectives.claim: The explanatory gap in consciousness is a permanent limit.
perspectives.summary: No amount of third-person description entails first-person experience, so the gap is principled rather than empirical.

perspectives.claim: The explanatory gap in consciousness is a permanent limit.
perspectives.summary: Apparent explanatory gaps have historically dissolved as science matured; the intuition may reflect current ignorance rather than a limit.
